# Little Hanniel

> A small family home bakery in Batam, Indonesia. We bake small batches of Overnight Oats (Tiramisu, Strawberry, Double Chocolate) and Almond Choco Cookies, made to order and delivered via WhatsApp.

## Products

- [Overnight Oats](https://littlehanniel.pages.dev/#menu) — Tiramisu, Strawberry, Double Chocolate. Made with rolled oats, chia seeds, roasted almonds, fresh fruit, and local honey. No refined sugar. Bake-to-order, Monday to Saturday.
- [Almond Choco Cookies](https://littlehanniel.pages.dev/#menu) — Almond cookies with dark chocolate chunks and roasted almonds.

## How to order

- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/message/OZUDXGIT5FJEE1
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/littlehanniel

## About

Little Hanniel began in 2024 as a family project — mum, dad, and the little ones making treats in our home kitchen for friends and neighbours. We take orders over WhatsApp and bake-to-order.
